benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.

result.summary: Balanced 128-state all-legal producer completed 32 rows per BB/SB flop/turn route with 192 samples per legal action and zero stderr. Half-to-full best-action agreement was 0.84375 with 0.09645 bb mean regret, but three-opponent best-action unanimity was only 0.34375 and minimum pairwise agreement 0.39844. Same-sample minimax results are selection-biased and not a training gate.
result.conclusion: Do not train directly from same-sample marginal argmax/LCB or present in-sample robust-selector value as heldout evidence.
result.next_step: Use exact-state independent hidden-hole/runout samples to cross-evaluate a source-relative robust target, then require cross-seed learned-weight stability.
